messages:
eli: Heads-up — since ~02:15 eu-west control plane started showing a high rate of api-server connection resets and controller-manager restarts. GPU pool backfills are timing out and some jobs fell to fallback. Noticing delta in SYN_RECV -> ESTABLISHED failures.
sara: Seeing alerts too, dashboard: https://graf.redwood/ctrlplane/eu-west1 — apiserver 5xx spike, connstates on nat-gw-3 at 99%.
karthik: nat-gw-3 conntrack counters are at cap. `conntrack -S` shows ~245k active, nf_conntrack_max=245760. Packets show many short-lived syns from gpu-provisioner.
maria-ops: ops-bot triggered scaling but pool didn't attach because apiserver 502s. Could be keepalive/timeouts on the proxy layer.
dennis: Any recent network changes in eu-west? I pushed a small NAT route tweak at 01:50 to rebalance egress.
eli: yep that tweak overlaps with the window. hypothesis: rebalance created transient flow churn; conntrack exhaustion -> SNAT failures -> apiserver half-open connections -> controller-manager restarts while waiting on API.
sara: quick mitigation idea: revert the NAT rebalance, increase nf_conntrack_max, and scale SNAT pool. Reverting now would reduce churn.
karthik: agree. Patch for conntrack can be applied via sysctl on bouncers: `sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=400000` and adjust `net.ipv4.netfilter.ip_conntrack_tcp_timeout_established` if needed.
maria-ops: cost note: spinning extra NAT instances adds ~$0.9/hr per instance in eu-west; estimate additional $650/day if we overscale aggressively.
dennis: revert deployed at 02:30. ops-bot: Revert of nat-rebalance completed (runbook 3.1). :white_check_mark:
sara: after revert, conntrack active dropped to ~120k in 5m, apiserver 5xx rate fell ~70%. controller-manager restarts stopped.
eli: good. Still seeing occasional attach failures from the provisioner where it retries many short connections — suggestion: add exponential backoff jitter in provisioner to avoid thundering syns.
karthik: I'll queue a small change: provisioner v1.12.3 adds jitter + connection pooling. Canary to 10% of requests in eu-west.
maria-ops: also let's add a temporary routing policy to prefer eu-central for large bulk GPU onboards until we stabilize. Ops playbook updated.
dennis: opened ticket INF-8254 to track follow-ups: increase conntrack, tune keepalives, provisioner retry logic, and cost-approved NAT autoscale.
ops-bot: alert muted for this incident; will auto-unmute in 2h unless manually cleared.
eli: plan for next 24h: 1) monitor canary (karthik) 2) staged conntrack bump on bouncers (sara) 3) cost check and NAT autoscale config (maria-ops) 4) postmortem if any regression (dennis).
maria-ops: thumbs up. I'll run the cost calc and slack the finance channel. :thumbsup:
karthik: pushing canary now, logs will be in /var/log/provisioner/canary.log and I’ll post results in #eng-sre.
eli: thanks everyone. Closing thread unless we see new 5xx flares. :pray:
